overview_description.description:
Ryan Huber and Nate Brown are the creators of Nebula, the scalable overlay networking tool they built and deployed to connect tens of thousands of servers while working together at Slack.

​Nebula was publicly announced and open sourced in late 2019. In February of 2020, Nate and Ryan left Slack to launch Defined Networking, a new company focused on bringing performant, simple, and secure networking products to organizations large and small.

about_short_description.short_description: Founded by the creators of slackhq/nebula, Defined Networking provides performant, simple, and secure mesh VPN software.

product.name: Nebula
product.description: An open-source mesh VPN software that establishes direct peer-to-peer encrypted connections between hosts for secure network overlay.

product.name: Managed Nebula
product.description: A managed service that simplifies the deployment and management of Nebula networks, including certificate authority and host configuration.

product.name: DNClient
product.description: Client software that connects devices securely to Nebula networks with end-to-end encryption and supports multiple platforms and architectures.

product.name: Relay Support in Nebula
product.description: A feature that enables traffic relaying through intermediary Nebula peers to ensure connectivity when direct peer-to-peer connections are not possible.

product.name: Advanced Firewall & Audit Logs
product.description: A system for managing inbound firewall rules based on roles and groups, with automatic updates and comprehensive audit logging of network changes.

product.name: Drop-in Encryption
product.description: A solution that enables encrypted, mutually authenticated network connections between servers without complex key management or centralized VPNs.
